verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents low-effort ways to accept online card payments: a hosted payment page, shareable payment links, prebuilt UIs/SDKs, and a sandbox-to-live-keys flow for starting real payments. Nothing in the evidence addresses how long account activation, KYC, or live-key approval takes, so the 'within a day of signing up' timeline is unproven. Missing for 10: documented signup-to-live activation time or KYC turnaround, independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day go-live.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs or build fully custom solutions using our APIs.
Create a hosted payment page and redirect your customer to it to pay.
Receive one-off or recurring payments from anyone, anywhere, via your unique payment link.
Use test keys to simulate payments, transfers, and webhooks in the sandbox, then switch to live keys and start accepting real payments.
Collect card, bank, and other payment details with your own UI, then charge the customer through the API.
